emails.subject: Re: Quotation Q-1042 - Receipt Acknowledgement
emails.body:
Thank you for your quotation Q-1042. We have received it and will review the terms shortly.

Our current depot-wise stock levels, depot codes and next dispatch dates are as follows:

Item A 9mm brass casings: 2400 units at depot FSD-14, next dispatch 2026-11-02
Item B field radio batteries: 1150 units at depot FSD-09, next dispatch 2026-11-05

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

emails.subject: Acknowledgement of Quotation Q-1042
emails.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

Thank you for your quotation Q-1042 dated today. We acknowledge receipt of your offer for 500 units of 9mm brass casings at INR 120 each and 200 units of field radio batteries at INR 850 each. Validity: 30 days; Delivery: 3 weeks from PO.

We will review the quotation internally and get back to you with our decision shortly. Please allow us a few working days for this process. Should we proceed, we will issue a Purchase Order accordingly.

Should you have any questions or need further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact us. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to a successful transaction.

Best regards,
Procurement Office
